functions.name: readCardProperties
functions.description: Every property of every card in an address book, keyed by the card UID the contacts API reports. Empty if the book does not exist.

parameters.name: bookUid
parameters.description: The address book's UID, as reported by the addressBooks API.

functions.name: setAddressBookReadOnly
functions.description: Set or clear the read-only flag on an address book, which blocks adding, modifying and deleting its cards. Returns false if the book does not exist.

parameters.name: bookUid
parameters.description: The address book's UID, as reported by the addressBooks API.

parameters.name: readOnly
parameters.description: True to freeze the book, false to release it.
